import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static class SAP {
        int[][] cap = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int[][] flow = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int[][] g = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int n;
        int[] h = new int[MAXN];
        int[] vh = new int[MAXN];
        int src, dst;
        int[] mk = new int[MAXN];

        void init(int nodes) {
            this.n = nodes;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
                Arrays.fill(flow[i], 0);
                Arrays.fill(g[i], 0);
            }
            Arrays.fill(mk, 0);
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            cap[u][v] += c;
            g[u][v] = 1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int limit) {
            if (u == dst) return limit;
            int pushed = limit, delta, minDist = n;
            for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
                if (cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0) {
                    if (h[u] == h[v] + 1) {
                        delta = dfs(v, Math.min(pushed, cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]));
                        flow[u][v] += delta;
                        flow[v][u] -= delta;
                        pushed -= delta;
                        if (h[src] == n || pushed == 0) return limit - pushed;
                    }
                    minDist = Math.min(minDist, h[v] + 1);
                }
            }
            if (pushed == limit) {
                vh[h[u]]--;
                vh[minDist]++;
                if (vh[h[u]] == 0) h[src] = n;
                h[u] = minDist;
            }
            return limit - pushed;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int d) {
            if (s == d) return INF;
            dst = d;
            src = s;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(flow[i], 0);
            }
            Arrays.fill(h, 0);
            Arrays.fill(vh, 0);
            int result = 0;
            while (h[src] != n) {
                result += dfs(src, INF);
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static class Point {
        int x, y, dist;
        Point(int x, int y, int dist) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.dist = dist;
        }
    }

    static int N, T;
    static int startX, startY;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dist1 = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] visited = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

    static int idx(int i, int j) {
        return (i - 1) * N + j;
    }

    static boolean inBounds(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 1 && x <= N && y >= 1 && y <= N;
    }

    static void bfs1() {
        Queue<Point> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Point cur = new Point(startX, startY, 0);
        q.offer(cur);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist1[i], 0x7f7f7f7f);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(visited[i], 0);
        }
        visited[startX][startY] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            cur = q.poll();
            dist1[cur.x][cur.y] = cur.dist;
            if (cur.dist > T) break;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = cur.x + dx[k], ny = cur.y + dy[k];
                if (inBounds(nx, ny) && grid1[nx][ny] != 'Y' && visited[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    Point nxt = new Point(nx, ny, cur.dist + 1);
                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                    q.offer(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int i, int j) {
        Queue<Point> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Point cur = new Point(i, j, 0);
        q.offer(cur);
        for (int x = 0; x < MAXN; x++) {
            Arrays.fill(visited[x], 0);
        }
        visited[i][j] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            cur = q.poll();
            if (cur.dist > T) break;
            if (dist1[cur.x][cur.y] < cur.dist) continue;
            if (dist1[cur.x][cur.y] == cur.dist && (grid2[cur.x][cur.y] < '1' || grid2[cur.x][cur.y] > '9')) continue;
            if (grid2[cur.x][cur.y] >= '1' && grid2[cur.x][cur.y] <= '9') {
                if (cur.x != i || cur.y != j) {
                    sap.addEdge(idx(i, j), idx(cur.x, cur.y) + N * N, INF);
                }
                if (dist1[cur.x][cur.y] == cur.dist) continue;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = cur.x + dx[k], ny = cur.y + dy[k];
                if (inBounds(nx, ny) && grid1[nx][ny] != 'Y' && visited[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    Point nxt = new Point(nx, ny, cur.dist + 1);
                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                    q.offer(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static SAP sap = new SAP();

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        N = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid1[i] = new char[MAXN];
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                grid1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid2[i] = new char[MAXN];
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                grid2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        int src = 0, dst = 2 * N * N + 1;
        sap.init(dst + 1);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j] >= '1' && grid1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sap.addEdge(src, idx(i, j), grid1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                sap.addEdge(idx(i, j), idx(i, j) + N * N, INF);
                if (grid2[i][j] >= '1' && grid2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sap.addEdge(idx(i, j) + N * N, dst, grid2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        bfs1();
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (grid1[i][j] >= '1' && grid1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    bfs2(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(sap.maxFlow(src, dst));
    }
}
